meta.name: biopython
meta.description: Comprehensive molecular biology toolkit. Use for sequence manipulation, file parsing (FASTA/GenBank/PDB), phylogenetics, and programmatic NCBI/PubMed access (Bio.Entrez). Best for batch processing, custom bioinformatics pipelines, BLAST automation. For quick lookups use gget; for multi-service integration use bioservices.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 处理分子生物学序列和自动分析生物信息数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常处理生物信息学数据，需要自动化分析流程。
copy.tagline_en: Manipulate molecular sequences and automate bioinformatics analysis.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly work with bioinformatics data and need automated analysis pipelines.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能处理生物信息学任务：读写序列文件、算统计量、比对、查 NCBI、跑 BLAST、建进化树等；会参考文档写 Python 代码并运行。
howto.when: 当用户提出读写生物序列文件、查询 NCBI 数据库、做序列比对等生物信息学需求时触发。

say.text: 帮我统计这个 FASTA 文件里每条序列的 GC 含量。
say.note: 会调用 Bio.SeqUtils 计算并输出。

say.text: 把这两条序列做全局比对，打印最优比对。
say.note: 会用 Bio.Align 生成比对结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can handle bioinformatics tasks: reading/writing sequence files, calculating statistics, aligning, querying NCBI, running BLAST, building phylogenetic trees, etc.; it writes and runs Python code based on reference docs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to read/write biological sequence files, query NCBI databases, perform sequence alignment, or similar bioinformatics tasks.

say_en.text: Help me count GC content for each sequence in this FASTA file.
say_en.note: Uses Bio.SeqUtils to calculate and print.

say_en.text: Use Biopython to download EU490707 from GenBank and convert to FASTA.
say_en.note: Fetches via Entrez and converts format.

say_en.text: Do a global alignment of these two sequences and print the best alignment.
say_en.note: Uses Bio.Align to produce the result.
